name: Scrolling Cards
title: Scrolling Cards
description: Full-bleed image cards that stack with synchronized, spring-driven scrolling motion.
summary: A contained image collection with colored glass borders and a shared GSAP timeline. Tune spring stiffness, friction, spacing, scale, and dimensions in Component Studio.
highlights: Full-bleed Virat Kohli photography with consistent image crops
A shared timeline keeps card entry and stack scaling synchronized
Spring stiffness and friction control the actual motion response
Contained scrolling that works inside Component Studio
Responsive card sizing with centered stack offsets
Scoped animation cleanup and a static reduced-motion layout
anatomy: <ol> sticky stage containing the ordered image cards
<article> colored glass border and full-bleed image

physics.description: ScrollTrigger sets a target progress for one GSAP timeline. A damped spring, integrated on the GSAP ticker, drives card movement and scaling together. The ticker stops when the stack settles and is removed on cleanup.

accessibility.role: region with an ordered list of articles

keyboard.key: Arrow keys / Page Up / Page Down

keyboard.description: Move to the beginning or end of the collection.

accessibility.aria: Named scroll region, ordered card list, optional collection heading, and descriptive image alt text.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Removes sticky stacking and scale animations, presenting every card in normal document flow.

bestPractices: Provide a unique id and descriptive alt text for each image.
Give the component an explicit height when overriding the default 600px frame.
Use imagePosition to keep the subject visible when images are cropped.
Increase friction to reduce spring bounce and stiffness for a faster response.

props.name: items
props.description: Images with id, image, imageAlt, and optional imagePosition and border color.

props.name: stackGap
props.description: Vertical gap in pixels between stacked card tops, clamped to 0–40 and fitted to the viewport.

props.name: scaleStep
props.description: Scale reduction per following card, clamped to 0–0.1 with a minimum final scale of 0.65.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness, clamped to 80–500. Higher values follow scroll changes more quickly.

props.name: friction
props.description: Spring damping, clamped to 12–60. Higher values reduce bounce and add resistance.

props.name: cardHeight
props.description: Preferred card height in pixels, clamped to 240–600 and fitted to the available viewport.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Card corner radius in pixels, clamped to 0–40.

props.name: showIntro
props.description: Show the collection introduction and scroll cue.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the scroll frame.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the keyboard-focusable scroll region.
